page.notes: The left margin note is set in small italic type and is partly damaged; its wording is a best reading: "Pretextus acquirendarum divitiarum ad externi cultus splendorem fuisse". The Greek words of the Pelusiota passage and "καταξηλίας" are doubtful and not checked letter by letter. The scan's left edge shows a dark book page, which is not transcribed. Final line "functorum" continues onto the next page.
